quotes.text: Core implementation is `commands/knowledge/{store,sync,learning,service,embeddings,import}.mjs`. The default store is `~/.tb-tools/knowledge`; SHA-256 content-addressed records are private by default, retrieval combines SQLite FTS with optional local MiniLM vectors, and `maxContextChars` defaults to 10,000. [Task 1]
